solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Flower produced for scented ointment

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river; the Po is Italy's longest river
produced means made

explanation.surface: A blossom is turned into a perfumed balm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is the crossword river: something that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: this is a perfumed hair grease, an ointment applied to the head.

clue.text: Joke is hard to beat

parts.note: a pun is a joke on words
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A joke that is difficult to top.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: to beat someone as a penalty is to discipline them.

clue.text: Tree with perfect nuts and a flower, knocked over

indicators.note: knocked over in a down clue means the whole lot is turned upward

parts.note: A1 means perfect, with the 1 taken as I
nuts means mad
a flower is a river; the Cam flows through Cambridge

explanation.surface: A tree, with ideal nuts and a bloom, gets felled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked over' reverses AI MAD A CAM.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: an Australian evergreen grown for its edible nuts is a tree.

clue.text: Witch admits love for cavalryman

indicators.note: admits means lets the next letter inside

parts.note: a dragon is a fierce, unpleasant woman, as is a witch
love is zero in tennis, O

explanation.surface: A sorceress confesses her love for a mounted soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a mounted infantry soldier of old was a cavalryman.

clue.text: Launch bombs at the front, the one still to go?

indicators.note: at the front picks the opening letter of the word bombs

parts.note: the final one to set off, last off, is the one still to go

explanation.surface: A countdown: bombs fired from the front, with one left waiting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bombs' looks like the verb that goes with 'Launch'; only its first letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: the noun for the moment a rocket leaves the pad is its launch.

clue.text: Architect caught in tricky role with more work to do

indicators.note: in means the letter goes into the scrambled word
tricky means awkward, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
busier means having more to do

explanation.surface: A designer trapped in a difficult part, taking on extra tasks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tricky' makes LEOR from ROLE, and 'in' puts C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: the Swiss-French modernist designer of the Villa Savoye was an architect.

clue.text: Company in rush to find cause of trouble

indicators.note: in means company goes inside the rush

parts.note: a surge is a sudden rush

explanation.surface: A business in a hurry to locate the source of its problems.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a scourge is a plague or affliction that brings suffering.

clue.text: Animal covered in soot, terrapin

indicators.note: covered in means the letters lie concealed in the words that follow

explanation.surface: A creature smeared with soot: a terrapin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrapin' looks like the animal, but the answer lies across soot and terrapin.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a river-dwelling mammal of the weasel family is an animal.

clue.text: In actuality, record brought up for surgery

indicators.note: In means the next piece goes inside actuality

parts.note: fact means actuality, reality

indicators.note: brought up in a down clue means the word for record is reversed

parts.note: a file is a record

explanation.surface: In real life, the evidence has been taken up for an operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In actuality' reads as 'in reality' but 'In' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: cosmetic tightening of the skin of the face is a type of surgery.

clue.text: German river, a river alongside isthmus?

indicators.note: alongside sets the short pieces next to the isthmus, after it

parts.note: an isthmus is a narrow strip of land, a neck

explanation.surface: A German river, a waterway lying beside a narrow strip of land.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition and the wordplay both mention rivers, which hides that one is just the letter R.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: this is a tributary of the Rhine flowing through Heidelberg in Germany.

clue.text: A Swiss dish splitting sides in classic puzzle

indicators.note: splitting means the dish forces its way between the two letters
the sides of a word are its outermost letters, here of classic

parts.note: rosti is a Swiss fried potato dish

explanation.surface: A Swiss dish dividing the sides of a classic puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a word game where the first letters of lines spell out a hidden word is a type of puzzle.

clue.text: Secondary food desired or otherwise

indicators.note: otherwise means in another way, so the letters are arranged differently

explanation.surface: Extra food, as wanted or not.
explanation.definitionFit: A description: a small dish served in addition to the main course is secondary food.

clue.text: One drawing game, quite a few not finishing

parts.note: draughts is a board game, checkers in the US

indicators.note: not finishing means the last letter is removed

parts.note: many means quite a few

explanation.surface: One game ends in a draw, with quite a few incomplete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawing' suggests a tied game; here it means drawing pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a person who makes technical drawings or plans is one drawing.

clue.text: Country retreat's opening onto Russian river

indicators.note: the opening of retreat is its first letter

parts.note: the Ural is a river in Russia flowing to the Caspian

explanation.surface: A retreat in the countryside starts on the bank of a Russian river.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: as an adjective, country life means life away from towns, in the countryside.

clue.text: Putting game on, I'm grateful when broadcast has covered one

indicators.note: has covered means the scrambled letters wrap round the next piece
broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are spread into a new order

parts.note: one is I as a Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Someone thankful that a putting game is on the TV.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Putting' as the golf stroke, not as placing.
explanation.definitionFit: A description: crazy golf on small courses is a game played entirely by putting.

clue.text: Music lover getting poorer with age, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests something gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A music fan getting poorer with age, sadly.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: a regular at the opera house is a lover of music.

clue.text: Feeling representation inappropriate at first, Tory has volume turned up initially

indicators.note: initially means this reversed piece comes at the start
turned up in a down clue means the book is reversed

parts.note: a tome is a large book, a volume

indicators.note: at first picks the first letter of inappropriate

parts.note: CON is short for Conservative, a Tory

explanation.surface: A Tory turns the volume up, which is inappropriate.
explanation.definitionFit: A description: a smiley face in a text represents a feeling.

clue.text: Whinger among men, I suspect, punched by local head of industry

indicators.note: punched by means the scrambled letters are broken into by the next pieces
suspect means dubious or not genuine, so the letters before it are rearranged

parts.note: a local is a pub, an inn

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of industry

explanation.surface: A complainer among the workforce, hit by the local captain of industry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspect' rearranges AMONG MEN I, and 'punched by' puts INN and I inside. The answer is British slang for someone who is always complaining.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: this British slang phrase names a person who constantly complains, a whinger.

clue.text: Ocean a bit choppy having wasted an Arctic vessel

indicators.note: choppy describes rough water, so the letters are churned up
having wasted means two letters of the pool are thrown away

explanation.surface: A rough sea has made the vessel lose an Arctic boat.
explanation.walkthrough: Shuffle OCEAN A BIT, then discard A and N.
explanation.definitionFit: A description: a boat on runners that sails across frozen water is an Arctic vessel.

clue.text: Most convenient to keep organ with a drum in home

indicators.note: in means the organ goes inside the home

parts.note: a nest is a home
the ear has an eardrum

explanation.surface: A handy place to keep an instrument with a drum at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drum' suggests music, but it is the eardrum.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: the closest thing is the handiest, most convenient one.

clue.text: Pen — what does it have in it that's smelly?

indicators.note: in it means the ink goes inside the pen

parts.note: a sty is a pig pen
a writing pen holds ink

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about what a pen contains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pen' is used twice: as a pig sty and, implied, as a writing pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: something that reeks is smelly.

clue.text: Championship game involving the likely leaders

indicators.note: involving means the game wraps around the next letters

parts.note: a tie is a match, a game in a competition

indicators.note: leaders are the first letters of the words the and likely

explanation.surface: A championship match with the likely winners in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: winning a championship means winning the title.

clue.text: First note, singer's second between two Cs?

indicators.note: between means the letter sits between the two parts

parts.note: one C as the Roman numeral 100 is TON, and the other C stays as it is

indicators.note: second picks the second letter of singer

explanation.surface: A singer's second note pitched between two Cs.
explanation.walkthrough: Read one C as 100 (TON), the other as plain C.
explanation.definitionFit: Musical term: the keynote, the first note of a scale.

clue.text: Turkish leader, not without guts, after name for hellcat

indicators.note: after means the following pieces come behind the name

parts.note: a term is a name for something
an aga is a commander in the Ottoman Empire

indicators.note: without guts means the middle of not is removed, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: A Turkish commander with no courage following a name for a fury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without guts' sounds like cowardice, but just removes the inside of 'not'.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: a hellcat is a violent, overbearing woman, a shrew or virago.

clue.text: Trick with battle to get something clear

parts.note: a con is a trick or swindle
the Somme was a First World War battle

explanation.surface: A wartime ruse that makes the plan obvious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'something clear' is a clear soup, not a plain fact.
explanation.definitionFit: A description: this is a clear soup made from strained stock.

clue.text: Drug required, as great woman gets cut

indicators.note: gets cut means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: a heroine is a woman admired for great deeds

explanation.surface: A notable woman wounded, needing medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: An example: diamorphine is an opiate drug.

clue.text: Poison in it inhaled by figure, as drug

indicators.note: inhaled by means taken inside the figure

parts.note: nine is a figure, a number

indicators.note: in puts the poison inside the word it

parts.note: carbon monoxide, chemical formula CO, is a poison

explanation.surface: Smoke breathed in as if it were a drug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poison' looks like the definition but is CO.
explanation.definitionFit: A description: the addictive stimulant in tobacco is a drug.

clue.text: Stable couple of articles removed from one of seven?

indicators.note: removed from means the articles are taken out of the day

parts.note: Saturday is one of the seven days of the week
a pair of the indefinite article a

explanation.surface: Something steady after dropping two items from a set of seven.
explanation.walkthrough: The two A's come out of different places in the day.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym: something firmly built and steady is stable.
